source.labelAr: المؤسسة العامة للغذاء والدواء — بحث الأسعار العام، جُمع في 17 تشرين الثاني 2026
source.labelEn: JFDA public price search — collected 17 November 2026
source.dateBasis: Public price including tax shown by the JFDA public drug search, collected 17 November 2026 by 676 searches. Listed zero and missing prices are not used. The collection was not verified as the complete JFDA catalogue. Where JFDA gives a price-active date on or before the collection date it is kept as effectiveDate.
